disclaimer: These adjustments reflect general veterinary nutrition guidance and are NOT personalized medical advice. Individual pets may require different targets. Always confirm with your vet. Pawtchi makes no medical claim.
_design_note: Launch scope is intentionally narrow — only conditions with broadly-accepted nutritional guidance and low risk of harm from a moderate restriction are included. Disease-specific conditions (CKD, diabetes, urolithiasis) are deferred until each can be gated behind explicit per-condition vet confirmation.

obesity.label: Obesity / Active weight-loss program

crude_fat.rationale: Lower-fat diet supports calorie restriction without sacrificing protein. WSAVA Body Condition guidelines recommend 9% DM fat ceiling on weight-loss diets, ≈25 g/1000 kcal at typical kibble energy density.

crude_protein.rationale: AAHA weight-management guidelines recommend ≥5 g protein/kg ideal BW/day to protect lean mass during restriction. At typical weight-loss diet energy density this is ≈75 g/1000 kcal.

mer_override.note: Weight-loss MER uses RER(target weight) rather than RER(current weight). Already implemented in lib/healthMath.ts calculateDailyKcal.

obesity.source: WSAVA Global Nutrition Guidelines; AAHA 2014 Weight Management Guidelines

pancreatitis_history.label: Pancreatitis (history of)

crude_fat.rationale: Lower-fat diet reduces pancreatic stimulation. ACVIM consensus on canine pancreatitis recommends fat restriction in dogs with a pancreatitis history; commonly implemented as ≤12% DM fat, ≈30 g/1000 kcal.

pancreatitis_history.source: ACVIM Consensus Statement on Pancreatitis in Dogs (2021); AAHA Nutritional Assessment Guidelines

large_breed_puppy.label: Large-breed puppy growth

calcium.rationale: Large- and giant-breed puppies are vulnerable to developmental orthopedic disease from excess calcium. AAFCO 2014 large-breed-growth profile caps calcium at 1.8% DM (≈4.5 g/1000 kcal) — strictly tighter than the all-life-stage range.

large_breed_puppy.source: AAFCO 2014 Large-Breed Growth Profile; WSAVA Global Nutrition Guidelines

_deferred_conditions._note: Schema is preserved here for the day each is gated behind explicit vet confirmation in-app. Do NOT auto-apply.

ckd_stage_2.deferred_reason: Phosphorus and protein restrictions for CKD require IRIS staging and ongoing lab monitoring; safer to surface a 'consult your vet' nudge than to auto-adjust

ckd_stage_3.deferred_reason: Same as ckd_stage_2 with stricter targets

diabetes.deferred_reason: Fiber and carbohydrate guidance for diabetic pets is dose-dependent on insulin therapy; needs vet collaboration

urolithiasis_oxalate.deferred_reason: Stone type drives diet (oxalate vs struvite need opposite mineral profiles); requires confirmed urinalysis
